web.title: Onboard Camera AI | Scrypted Docs
web.description:
# Onboard Camera AI [​](https://docs.scrypted.app/scrypted-nvr/camera-ai.html#onboard-camera-ai)
Some camera hardware provides onboard AI that detects people, animals, and vehicles. Those detections can be used by Scrypted NVR to reduce server load.

- The camera provided detections do not provide bounding boxes around the object. As a result, notifications and thumbnails will be full frame images, unlike the rich notifications provided by `Scrypted NVR Object Detection`.
- Detections are not searchable in the Scrypted NVR app.
